FLEXPORT: THREE DISTINCT ECONOMIC CHANNELS | G4-G6
Focused compounding and subsequent financial evidence
|
+-- 1. Equity-method investment
|   [R] Year                     2023    2024    2025
|   [R] Carrying value ($M)       780     642     602
|   [R] Recognized loss ($M)       58     138      40
|   [R] 2024 disclosure: reporting uses a one-quarter delay.
|   [R] Loss includes basis-difference amortization in 2023.
|   [X] Equity carrying value increased over 2023-25.
|   [I] Carrying value is not market value or total economic return.
|
+-- 2. Separate convertible note
|   [R] Purchased December 2023: $260M.
|   [R] Fair value: $291M FY2024; $326M FY2025.
|   [R] Interest income: $32M in 2024; $35M in 2025.
|   [I] Do not add $67M interest to fair-value growth as total return;
|       the excerpts do not establish non-overlapping components.
|
+-- 3. Commercial agreement and co-marketing
|   [R] November 2023: Shopify entitled to a share of order revenue.
|   [R] Recognized agreement revenue: nil in 2024 and 2025.
|   [R] Filing says agreement transactions will be eliminated.
|   [I] Scope of elimination is cut off in the supplied excerpt.
|   [I] Nil recognized revenue does not establish zero merchant usage.
|   [R] Co-marketing expense: $4M in 2024; $9M in 2025.
|
`-- Partnership -[D:untestable]-> sustained merchant benefit
    [I] No post-sale merchant outcome series in the supplied excerpts.
    [I] Avoided logistics losses are a possible benefit, not quantified.
Evidence: P1-P5.
